purpose: Gap G6 / Vector E — ground the anti-EDoS autoscaling-abuse policy

per_request_separability.reading: Per-request features are WEAKLY separable (|d| small) — empirically confirms the paper's thesis that EDoS/Vector E evades per-request detection, motivating aggregate/economic defenses (PSRG + anti-EDoS cap).

source_concentration.grounds: PSRG transaction-context limits over per-IP limits: attacker IPs each fire ~175x more invocations than a benign IP.

autoscaling_amplification.grounds: The sawtooth: functions scale from ~26 active at request to ~996 at response — the concurrency blow-up the anti-EDoS cap must bound.

denial_of_wallet_cost.grounds: DoW economic damage: 70% of total compute is attacker-driven, concentrated on very few IPs — the loss the anti-EDoS policy prevents.
